preconditions.expression: len(h1) == 3 and all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**5 for x in h1)
preconditions.description: The first line of input must contain exactly three non-negative integers representing the Hamming distances between s1 and s2, s1 and s3, and s1 and s4.

preconditions.expression: len(h2) == 2 and all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**5 for x in h2)
preconditions.description: The second line of input must contain exactly two non-negative integers representing the Hamming distances between s2 and s3, and s2 and s4.
The third line of input must contain exactly one non-negative integer representing the Hamming distance between s3 and s4.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('-1') or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == 5 and all(len(line) == len(stdout.splitlines()[1]) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no suitable set of strings exists, output '-1'. Otherwise, output the length of the strings followed by four strings of equal length.

postconditions.expression: all(hamming_distance(stdout.splitlines()[i+1], stdout.splitlines()[j+1]) == h1[i] for i in range(3) for j in range(i+1, 3)) and all(hamming_distance(stdout.splitlines()[i+1], stdout.splitlines()[j+1]) == h2[i] for i in range(2) for j in range(i+1, 2)) and hamming_distance(stdout.splitlines()[2], stdout.splitlines()[3]) == h3
postconditions.description: The output strings must have the correct pairwise Hamming distances as specified in the input.
